description: Built 1957, flown by Air France 1957-1968 and later as a freighter; brought to Munich in 1993 and restored 2000-2001, displayed in Lufthansa colours as D-ALEM. Open-air display at the Munich airport visitors park; the airport's own 2025 page names these three historic aircraft.

Built 1941; flown by Pan Am and DDL until 1976 and moved to Munich from Frankfurt in 1993. Known locally as the Rosinenbomber. Open-air display at the Munich airport visitors park; the airport's own 2025 page names these three historic aircraft.

Spanish-built Ju 52 variant of 1949, ex-Spanish Air Force; last flew Stuttgart to Frankfurt on 14 September 1974 and was acquired by the airport company in March 2000. Open-air display at the Munich airport visitors park; the airport's own 2025 page names these three historic aircraft.
